beats.story: The penultimate hour of work ticks along to the beat of the ancient wall clock. Stu Wilkins has been hunched over the printer in front of his pod for the past fifteen minutes, watching sheets of paper spit out in one-second intervals like some twisted form of corporate meditation. All these people, with their thoughts floating so close, sitting beside one another in complete silence. Nobody ever randomly screams during these moments -- a phenomenon that should be studied. Stu's printer beeps, begging for more paper. He leans far too close, pulling on his reading glasses that hang from his neck, and rubs his head like he's trying to interpret ancient scripture. Right, it's time to call the time of death for the workday. As if on cue, the main-floor door beeps and in walks Randal the security guard.
beats.story_cn: 下班前的最后一小时，随着老式挂钟的节拍滴答流逝。过去十五分钟，Stu Wilkins一直埋头蹲在工位打印机前，看着纸张以每秒一张的频率吐出，活像某种诡异的企业冥想仪式。所有人的思绪都近在咫尺，彼此并肩而坐却沉默如谜。这种时刻从来没人会突然尖叫——这种现象简直值得立项研究。Stu的打印机哔哔作响，讨要更多纸张。他凑得过近，拽下挂在脖子上的老花镜，揉着脑袋活像在解读上古经文。好了，是时候为今天的工作宣布临床死亡了。恰在此时，主楼层门禁滴滴响起，保安Randal踱步而入。

beats.story: Security personnel come to workspaces only for big issues or to let maintenance in to work on the mostly ornamental thermostats. As Randal turns down the hall, Garret comes running across the floor. "Somebody's locked themselves in an office! Somebody that was let go!" he shouts, sounding a little too delighted by this drama. Rhonda snaps her gum. "Oh dear." Quiet murmurs move through the room, heads peeking up from cubicles like face cards from a Guess Who? board. A few bolder types storm toward the hallway where most of the offices are, but Randal holds up his hands and guides them to stand back.

beats.story: "Everyone, please stay in your workspaces until the situation has been resolved." Randal has a sheen of sweat on his forehead; this is the event of his career. Normally this is the type of chaos I have a soft spot for, but after today, I'm just not up for it. So I stay at my desk. Then comes the email. From: Larry Goodwin To: All Staff -- Supershops Subject: Fuck You Colleagues, Today will be my last day at Supershops. Regrettably, reason and morale are at an all-time low and nobody cares about each other anymore. A lot of you have made my life wonderful here. And you know who you are.
beats.story_cn: “各位请留在工位，等待事态处理完毕。”Randal额头泛着汗光——这可是他职业生涯的高光时刻。平日里我最爱看这种混乱场面，但经此一天，实在无心凑热闹。我留在了座位上。接着邮件来了。发件人：Larry Goodwin 收件人：全体同事——超级商场 主题：去你们的同事们，今天将是我在这座超市的最后一天。遗憾的是，理性与士气已跌至谷底，再无人彼此关切。你们中许多人曾让我在此度过美妙时光。你们自知是谁。

Nobody notices the things I do for this office. In a couple weeks, you bitches will all have watermarks on your glassware without me to refill the Jet-Dry, and you don't care. I may have been terminated, but I won't be leaving until the end of the day, and I thank you all for letting me have that. Don't fear for me. Fear for you.

beats.story_cn: 拉里·古德温。笑声像断断续续的浪涌，起初还带着迟疑和含糊，最终席卷了整个楼层。奥利维亚·埃斯皮诺萨，那位热心肠的消防主管，在慌乱中套上了她的消防背心。凯特琳和乔伊冲向加勒特的办公桌，而兰德尔正对着所有人大喊，要求保持原位。他从腰带上扯下对讲机，对着话筒低声念出几串代码。对讲机里传来一阵嘈杂的静电杂音，他举到耳边听了听，最终放弃，掏出了自己的手机。五分钟过去了，什么事也没发生，楼层里的能量随着这无疾而终的闹剧开始消散。这时，走廊里传来一声怒吼：“不行！至少得让我把话说完！”——拉里·D。

Cliff's eyes search across the floor. They land on me and hold. The HR emergency -- it was real.

beats.story: He wasn't just avoiding me. "You people manipulate each other all day," Larry announces. Everyone looks at one another, each of them innocent in their hearts. "Is this really the life you want?" he tries again. Again, blank stares. Except, alone in my cubicle, his question presses into me. He gestures behind him at Cliff. "He's just here to fire us, piece by piece." Cliff rolls his jaw, arms stiff.
beats.story_cn: 他不仅仅是在躲着我。“你们整天就在互相算计。”拉里宣布道。众人面面相觑，各自心里都觉得自己清白。“这真是你们想要的生活吗？”他再次发问。回应他的依然是茫然的眼神。除了独自坐在隔间里的我——他的问题像楔子钉进心头。他朝身后的克里夫比划。“这家伙来这儿就是要把我们一个个裁掉。”克里夫咬紧牙关，双臂僵硬。

beats.story: But I catch the way his eyes flash. He hates the truth of it. Larry's face has gone the color of an eggplant. "Gregory's a fucking tool that only got scones for the cool kids!" Gregory's eyebrows shoot up at the same rate my stomach drops. "What?" Beside me, Armin coughs. "All right," says Cliff. "Larry, it's time to -- " Larry grabs for his belt and it happens so fast: he turns and flashes his butt cheeks. Randal throws out his arms to shield the innocents, and Larry takes the opportunity to bend right under them like he's playing a game of limbo and starts running around the desks, still squatting.
beats.story_cn: 但我捕捉到他眼中一闪而过的怒意。他恨这真相。拉里的脸涨成了茄子色。“格雷戈里不过是个给酷小孩端松饼的狗腿子！”格雷戈里眉毛扬起的同时，我的胃猛地一沉。“什么？”身旁的阿尔敏咳嗽起来。“好了，”克里夫说，“拉里，你该——”拉里一把扯住腰带，一切发生得太快：他转身亮出两瓣屁股。兰德尔张开手臂想护住无辜者，拉里却顺势从他臂弯下钻过，活像在玩下腰躲杆游戏，然后弓着腿绕着办公桌狂奔起来。

Then he picks up the Yoda plushie from Jean Adler's desk and sticks it in his pants.
